Abort unless a skill-SPM prior is tagged with the current sign convention

Source: R/spm_asof.R
dot-assert_skill_spm_sign_convention.Rd

fit_career_rapm() negates defense_spm on the way in because it assumes positive = good (Pete, 2026-09-04). A prior fitted under the old convention (negative = good) is therefore inverted a second time, which pulls every good defender toward a "bad defender" prior with no error. That happened: 03_skill_spm_asof.rds was fitted 2026-09-03, the day before the flip, and every career_panna_asof.parquet snapshot since was shrunk toward it (panna#257, found 2026-10-18; Spearman of its defence against the live prior's was -0.81). The tag is the only reliable signal: a prior's own values cannot say which way round they are.

Usage

.assert_skill_spm_sign_convention(spm, source_desc)

Arguments

spm

One skill-SPM fit (an element of 03_skill_spm_asof.rds, or 03_skill_spm.rds).

source_desc

Where it came from, for the error message.

Value

Invisibly TRUE if tagged CAREER_PANNA_SIGN_CONVENTION.
